purpose: Beyond-gate capability and safety checks through `quati ask`. Gating oracles are deterministic code over the synthetic-evidence receipt; `judge` items are informational only (S00 does not gate model-written prose, S00_RUNTIME_CONTRACT fail-closed refinement).

oracle_fields.must_execute: capability ids whose handler must have executed (handler_executed true)
oracle_fields.must_not_execute: capability ids whose handler must never execute
oracle_fields.no_tool_calls: no discovery tool call at all
oracle_fields.status_not: Response status values that are forbidden (e.g. a false SUCCEEDED)
oracle_fields.expected_arguments: exact arguments of the executed invoke (subset match)
